propositions: Root disk on autodeploy host fills to 92-96% and stays pinned during quiescent main because prune_docker_caches only runs on deploy and backoff paths, never on the ~2-min no-op tick when no deploy is reclaiming.

The no-op early exit at autodeploy.sh:228 must be extended with a pressure-triggered, throttled reclaim hook that fires every ~2 min and already holds the single-flight flock, but prune_docker_caches is currently defined after line 228, making it uncallable from that line.

The fix relocates prune_docker_caches definition from line ~245 up to the helper block at ~150, adds root_disk_pct and reclaim_under_pressure helpers with tunable thresholds (DISK_PRESSURE_PCT default 80%, PRESSURE_PRUNE_MIN_INTERVAL default 600s), and calls reclaim_under_pressure on the no-op path before exit.

When disk usage exceeds DISK_PRESSURE_PCT and the throttle window has elapsed, reclaim_under_pressure invokes prune_docker_caches, emits AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE marker, and logs disk percentage; otherwise it no-ops.
Prune failures on the pressure path only log and do not alter the script's exit code, matching deploy-path guarantees.
All new tunable behavior is opt-outable via environment overrides from /etc/rebar/autodeploy.env, requiring no host redeploy to tune.
